name: kfold_oof_maps
author: first_agent
purpose: Out-of-fold finished maps on training shots, so that map-aware correctors (X-point first) are fitted on errors the ensemble makes on unseen shots. All 65 v25 members saw every training shot (50 also calibration), so every earlier finished-map residual was in-sample.
fold_rule: int(sha256(stem),16) % 5 over splits.json training minus reserved_for_evaluation (18)
reserved_per_fold: reserved_for_evaluation stems + the fold training stems, passed as --reserved to fit_on_accelerators (excluded from training and calibration tables)
subensemble: S16: recipe indices [0, 1, 2, 14, 16, 17, 22, 24, 30, 31, 33, 41, 42, 43, 44, 45] = 4 c, 4 h, 3 hx, 5 hc; each with its ORIGINAL settings, seed and train_on_calibration flag; bank members get the original-geometry readout refit afterwards with the same fold excluded
family_table_rule: label-column subset of tables_lcfs_discharge; verified identical to the family tables on calibration (all other arrays bitwise equal); training part checked by kfold_verify_tables.py before use
hardware: workstation ROCm (jax 0.8.2, RX 6600 XT) and Kaggle CUDA (jax[cuda12] 0.8.2, 2x T4); platform recorded per fit; numeric differences between platforms are expected and recorded, not corrected
downstream: (1) readout-bank refit per fold, (2) v25 finisher flags (fixed_axis_volume_full357_56cb build_report) on a deterministic sample of each fold held-out shots, (3) map-aware correctors fitted and evaluated by nested cross-fitting over folds only; validation stays untouched until one frozen corrector passes, then ONE full357 official-scorer screen

d4_variant.change: every member label_weight 0.2 (was 0.05; discharge_h_labels02_s76 already 0.2 = reproducibility control); names +_lw02; everything else identical (seeds, families, calibration flags, fold rule)
